subject.title: Subagent sessions persist after completion, main session becomes unresponsive

question: Should completed one-shot subagent sessions be retained as inspectable history, hidden/archived from active/default views after final delivery, or deleted according to archiveAfterMinutes?
rationale: Current source and docs disagree, and each path changes user-visible history, attachment retention, Control UI status, and recovery behavior.

options.title: Retain But Hide Or Archive
options.body: Keep completed subagent history inspectable while excluding terminal one-shot rows from active/default session and status views after final delivery settles.

options.title: Delete After Final Delivery Or TTL
options.body: Make run-mode subagent cleanup remove child session rows according to archiveAfterMinutes, accepting reduced default history retention.

options.title: Keep Current Retention
options.body: Document that cleanup=keep preserves completed rows and focus only on status honesty plus manual maintenance tooling.

recommendation.title: Retain But Hide Or Archive
recommendation.body: Keep completed subagent history inspectable while excluding terminal one-shot rows from active/default session and status views after final delivery settles.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current routing signal for the central session/subagent cleanup and responsiveness surfaces in this checkout.
